finiteAdaptations: Configured trusted plugins are supplied by the owning Svelte runtime composition rather than Astro virtual-module startup.
Optional import.meta.env?.DEV preserves the genuine development flag and excludes the console provider on unbundled Node without that flag.
Always-enabled builtin hooks are separate from the configured list, as in Source; default moderation participates as an exclusive fallback without persisting the fallback selection.
withdrawnAssumption: The earlier configured-kernel assertion that disabling its sole configured plugin removes every hook was invalid because Source builtins remain registered. Corrected assertions verify configured activate/deactivate hooks are removed. Raw first failure remains.
